KYC pass rate: why it fell and what to do

The KYC pass rate (approval among recorded decisions) fell from 88.7% to 83.3% between the two periods (−5.4 pp), or −2,945 approvals.

52,075 recorded decisions, one per user. Prior period: Jul 25 – Aug 23, 2023; recent period: Aug 24 – Sep 22, 2023. Aggregated data, no personal data.
